name: MessageSkeleton
description: The boxes of a loading turn, or an assistant-only reply, with stable loaded geometry.

props.name: card
props.description: Include the result-card placeholder. Default: true.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of prose skeleton lines. Default: 3.

props.name: prompt
props.description: Include the loading prompt bubble. Set false when only an assistant reply is loading. Default: true.
